description: This file defines a mock class ColorMock for unit testing. The class inherits from device::FrontPanelIndicator::ColorImpl and uses Google Mock to mock its methods, enabling tests to simulate and verify interactions with Color objects in the frontend panel indicator module.

classes.name: ColorMock
classes.description: A mock class for device::FrontPanelIndicator::ColorImpl, used in unit testing scenarios to verify interactions with color-related functionalities.
